_readme: A narrative = an itinerary through the items. Each narrative has an 'order' array of ids (from items.json) that defines prev/next.
The same item can appear in more than one narrative, even in a different order.
Three narratives, as agreed by the team: 'timeline' (Historical, required), 'from-subject-to-film' and 'bologna-walk'.
The earlier 'Renzi: Many Lives' idea (critic / curator / soldier-partisan) was dropped; its spirit survives in the three rooms of the museum (see rooms in items.json).
Orders for the last two follow data/text_grid.md (Claudia's draft); the Notion table lists the Bologna narrative in a different order -- to confirm.
